mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% in a monthly reading, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 100, manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate output capacity and earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 2-year window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over prior three months, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In slow GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized < 2.0%), weak residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth < 2.0% AND RSAFS decline AND HOUST decline
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when trigger condition is met, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates dual sector stress that signals corporate earnings deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and UNRATE decline, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.
